574-4677-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 green Elemental creature token
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-4677-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2023-4518-5434-6723.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-1832-3845-4050.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-3845-4050.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

465-585-3742-4251-7175.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Phantom Steed to become a Samurai until end of turn.
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping it and all Samurai you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

1537-3817-6542-8095.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5220-5243-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5243-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1086-3179-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Anointer Priest trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1086-3179-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1591-2459-3558-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1591-2459-3558-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

2034-4871-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Squirrels.
2034-4871-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Squirrels, adding six {C}
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers three times, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

240-4050-5929.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Leyline of Transformation, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4050-5929.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4365-4552-7280.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it
with two or more loyalty counters on it

539-851-3301-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

215-4010-6723-6965.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-4010-6723-6965.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 3 or greater

454-1978-2436.description:
Cause Marwyn to become an artifact using Phyrexian Scriptures.
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Marwyn.
Repeat from step 2.

862-5220-5256-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds
When Crimson Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

643-2511-4338.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Maskwood Nexus, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

6712-6780-6781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that has haste and/or flash.
6712-6780-6781.description:
Cast Your Temple Is Under Attack by paying {2}{W}, giving creatures you control indestructible until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Shaman by sacrificing an artifact, dealing 1 damage to each creature without flying.
Sonic's second ability triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that was dealt damage, creating that many tapped Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

955-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1315-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
654-1315-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

238-2034-5756.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gerrard, adding {C}{C}.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Havi, adding {C}{C}.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

428-1694-1817-5541.notablePrerequisites:
Bazaar Trader does not have summoning sickness.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
428-1694-1817-5541.description:
Activate Bazaar Trader by tapping it, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, creating a copy of the Ghyrson Starn spell that isn't legendary.
Resolve both Ghyrson Starn spells.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 7.

225-565-1987-4125.notablePrerequisites:
You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
225-565-1987-4125.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, targeting Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing land.
Orvar triggers, creating a copy of the mana-producing land.
When the land token enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate the nontoken land by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking the land and Shipwreck Dowser.
When the land and Shipwreck Dowser enter the battlefield, Shipwreck Dowser and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate the land token by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land token.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger from step 8, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
225-565-1987-4125.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Ghostly Flicker targeting any other permanent(s).

147-797.notablePrerequisites:
There is an artifact or creature on the battlefield.
You have enough mana to cast Stolen Identity
147-797.description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature or artifact.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Stolen Identity, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Stolen Identity, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

116-2569-5400.notablePrerequisites:
Synth Infiltrator is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Synth Infiltrator do not have summoning sickness.
116-2569-5400.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Synth Infiltrator.
Activate Synth Infiltrator by tapping it.
When Synth Infiltrator becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Synth Infiltrator's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

2060-2445-2700-2744-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Arcbound Shikari.
When Arcbound Shikari enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Arcbound Shikari trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other artifact creature you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

565-1283-2719-2909.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {4}, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens using their second abilities, or target any other permanent.

1121-5259.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
1121-5259.description:
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Mischievous Quanar's morph ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, turning it face up.
Mischievous Quanar triggers, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the copy of Rude Awakening, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mischievous Quanar by paying {3}{U}{U}, turning it face down.
Repeat from step 3.
If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then use to activate Mischievous Quanar to get infinite copies of any other instant and/or sorcery spell(s) on the stack.

575-1207-2034.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken Forest.
575-1207-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken Forest, which is a creature due to Ambush Commander, adding {C}{C}.
When the Forest dies, Yedora triggers, returning the Forest from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Repeat.

547-3519-4115.notablePrerequisites: You do not control another Drake or have a Drake in your graveyard.
547-3519-4115.description:
Cast Angler Drake by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Volo triggers, creating a copy of the Angler Drake spell.
The Angler Drake copy enters, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Food Chain by exiling the Angler Drake token, adding seven blue mana that can only be spent on creature spells.
Angler Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

1657-4535-5256.description:
Sacrifice Murderous Redcap to Altar of Dementia to mill target player 2.
Murderous Redcap's persist triggers, returning it to the battlefield.
Murderous Redcap returns to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter which cancel out.
Murderous Redcap triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2397-2781-3908.description:
Cast Spark Double having it enter as a copy of Felidar Guardian.
It enters and blinks Felidar and a land.
Tap the land for mana.
Felidar Guardian enters blinking a land and Spark Double.
Tap the land.
Repeat.

364-614-1987-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
